input: Plan a themed movie marathon night with roommates

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing the theme (genre, franchise, director, decade, etc.) determines which movies get picked and how everything else — decor, snacks, dress code — gets tied together.
The number of roommates and their movie preferences or restrictions (e.g. horror-averse, subtitles OK) directly shapes the film selection and how group decisions are made.
The date and start time set how many movies can realistically fit and whether it is a casual weeknight or a full weekend event.
A budget cap determines how much can be spent on streaming rentals, snacks, decorations, and any themed props.
Knowing which streaming services or physical media the group already has access to narrows down the actual film options immediately.
The desired vibe — cosy and low-key vs. immersive and dressed-up — changes how much effort goes into decor, themed food, costumes, and activities between films.
Understanding what a great outcome looks like (e.g. everyone stays awake, a specific number of films watched, a memorable shared experience) helps prioritise the right details.

gold.taskTitle: Plan a themed movie marathon night with roommates
gold.taskDescription: Organise a fun, themed movie marathon night at home with roommates, covering everything from theme selection to snacks and scheduling.

questions.title: What theme or genre are you leaning toward?
questions.description: Identify the central theme — e.g. a specific franchise, genre (horror, rom-com), decade (80s classics), or director — to anchor all other decisions.

questions.title: How many roommates are joining, any viewing preferences?
questions.description: Establish the group size and any hard preferences or aversions (e.g. no gore, subtitles fine) so the film shortlist works for everyone.

questions.title: Which evening are you planning this for?
questions.description: Pin down the date and rough start time to determine how many films realistically fit and how late the night can run.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the night?
questions.description: Set a spending ceiling covering rentals, snacks, drinks, decorations, and any themed extras.

questions.title: Which streaming services or media does your household have?
questions.description: Know what is already accessible (Netflix, physical DVDs, etc.) to immediately narrow down feasible film options without extra rental costs.

questions.title: How immersive do you want the experience to feel?
questions.description: Gauge whether the group wants a relaxed sofa night or a fully themed event with costumes, themed snacks, decorations, and between-film activities.

questions.title: What would make this night feel like a total success?
questions.description: Clarify the ideal outcome — e.g. hitting a set number of films, everyone staying engaged, creating a memorable tradition — to prioritise the right effort.
